digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify matrix and pytest coverage configuration
propositions: Coverage tracing is redundantly collected on Ubuntu Python 3.11, 3.12, and 3.13 with identical source and test selection, adding runner occupancy without additional verdict depth.
Benchmark experiment measured 34-second median wall-clock delta per uninstrumented cell, confirming coverage instrumentation as the occupancy cost.

Ubuntu Python 3.13 should be designated the sole coverage-collection cell while 3.11 and 3.12 retain all tests uninstrumented, matching precedent from ropeable-hydrated-siskin and OSS consensus (Django, NumPy, SciPy).

Workflow contract must enforce that exactly Ubuntu 3.13 receives both coverage flags while all other matrix cells (3.11, 3.12, macOS 3.13) receive neither, with explicit non-empty/empty-string encoding to avoid GitHub Actions falsy trap.

Production code contains no sys.version or sys.version_info branches, so behavioral compatibility remains covered by retaining all four OS/Python cells and both pytest tiers while eliminating only duplicate tracing.
